args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Rollback:** I took us-east, us-west and eu-west from v2.3.1 back to v2.3.0, which is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Before the rollback, v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Check:** After the rollback, the service shows as healthy in every region and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened INC-0001 as a SEV2 for checkout-api, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the next step: find out why v2.3.1 failed before deploying it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
